subtitle: Lesson 21 · On-Call and Operational Excellence

eyebrow: Building a rotation that holds up

steps.label: Pick rotation length deliberately
steps.sub: one week vs. 3-4 days is a real trade-off, not a default

steps.label: Add a real secondary
steps.sub: an escalation policy with a timeout, not a verbal promise

steps.label: Pay for the pager
steps.sub: a stipend, per-page pay, or comp time — not free overtime

eyebrow: A secondary that actually backs up the primary
code:
# Escalation policy, conceptually:
Step 1: Page primary on-call.  Wait 5 minutes for acknowledgment.
Step 2: No ack?  Page secondary on-call.  Wait 5 minutes.
Step 3: No ack?  Page the engineering manager / escalation lead.
caption: No acknowledgment within 5 minutes escalates automatically — not optionally.

steps.label: Worse escalation judgment
